segments.text: What if Light had to explain every name to L before the notebook worked? Mandatory peer review.
segments.label: JUSTICE NEEDS A SOURCE

segments.text: This rule pauses entries. Light gives a reason. L can challenge it. Terrible news for arrogance.
segments.label: A DIFFERENT NOTEBOOK RULE

segments.text: Light says someone looks guilty. My guy, cheekbone analysis isn't a criminal justice system.
segments.label: THE FIRST EXCUSE

segments.text: Then he cites online agreement. L asks for the original report. The god complex needs a bibliography.
segments.label: THE FOLLOW UP QUESTION

segments.text: Ryuk watches humans recreate a terrible university group project. Somebody pass the apples.
segments.label: RYUK BOUGHT FRONT ROW SEATS

segments.text: Light tries a longer speech. Dramatic breathing doesn't make guesses facts. Incredible discovery.
segments.label: CONFIDENCE IS NOT PROOF

segments.text: L compares the explanations. Why does criticism suddenly count as guilt? Why is evidence optional?
segments.label: FOLLOW THE CONTRADICTION

segments.text: Light's justice bends around his ego. Very convenient weather system. Bro appointed himself the whole forecast.
segments.label: THE MASK STARTS SLIPPING

segments.text: L isn't automatically correct either. Both geniuses can miss evidence. The notebook doesn't delete uncertainty.
segments.label: THE REAL CHANGE

segments.text: Their duel becomes defending conclusions instead of delivering smug indoor monologues with stationery.
segments.label: A DIFFERENT KIND OF DUEL

segments.text: Ryuk asks when they'll finish. L requests supporting documents. Supernatural horror has become an academic hearing.
segments.label: EVEN THE SHINIGAMI IS TIRED

segments.text: Light wanted unquestioned authority. His final boss is somebody calmly asking for evidence. Source, bro. Show the source.
segments.label: THE FINAL BOSS IS CITATIONS
